plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control hallmark pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The DESeq2 differential expression of psoriasis lesional vs control skin (6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon counts) is already computed and delivered as de_results.csv. The research question asks only which hallmark pathways change, so this plan does not re-fit the DE model; it (1) runs a sample-structure QC on the raw counts to characterize sample_01's low library size (~4x below median) and confirm it is not an identity/QC failure warranting removal, then reports that as inherited context for the enrichment; (2) runs fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic ('stat' column, chosen and stated per the disputed ranking-metric rule) against MSigDB Hallmark (50 sets, human, 2026.1 release, present in the reference store), with Reactome and WikiPathways human as second and third collections per the standard follow-up rule, each reported and pinned to its own release, never merged into one list; (3) synthesizes a report stating the contrast direction/sign convention inherited from de_results.csv, the ranking metric, the gene set size window (15-500), redundancy collapsing, leading-edge genes per significant hallmark set, and the method-dependence caveat. No new differential expression is fitted — the enrichment consumes the delivered de_results.csv contrast (treated vs control) directly.
